main_text.p: filia a Patre vendita, postliminio revertens à Patre iterum vendi possit. Alii affirmant, alii negant, & rationes exponunt, niuntur autem varia punctatione [?] בבזרו ; alii volunt legi בבזרו alii בבזרו eo quod perfide egit. Ter aut quater paucis verbis repetunt dictionem בבזרו alii volunt legi בבזרו alii1 contendunt legi בבזרו. Necesse omnino erat tum, aut figuras punctorum, aut nomina saltem exprimere, ut unum ab altero scribendo distingverent. Id illustratur ex locis in qvibus sub eadem formula de dictionibus disputant; ne legas מה sed מאח est enim manifesta distinctio unius ab altero, nec est necessaria punctorum inscriptio, satis enim distinguit litterarum varietas expressa. Sed quid hoc sibi vult, ne legas זכר sed זכר. Ne legas בוזרו sed בזרו hoc illustrandum exemplo superiore caput, &c. Confirmat, hoc dvod[?] aliqvando vocales matres lectionis addunt, ut hæc distinguant. v. g. Sanhedrim f. 4. ubi disputantes de immunditie puerperæ, an du-

page.notes: Hebrew words are small and partly unclear; the forms written here are my best reading and should be checked against the scan, especially the first Hebrew word after "ne" and the pointed forms. "alii" after the second dictio carries a superscript mark, rendered as <sup>1</sup>. Small printed marks (star before "&c.", dots in the text) are not transcribed as text. The word "dvod" is possibly a misprint for "quod".
